bearerAuth.description: Honest note: LocalePak currently issues NO bearer tokens and has no token endpoint, so this scheme is documented for completeness only — do not send an Authorization header. Public reads (all operations in this document) require no authentication (security: []). Scopes used by LocalePak: "listings:read" (public read-only access — no token needed) and "listings:write" (listing-owner writes, which happen only in a signed-in website session at https://www.localepak.com/dashboard — never through this API). See /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server and /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource.

info.description: Read-only public API for LocalePak, Pakistan's business directory (183 cities, 24 categories). All reads are free and need no API key, token, or signup. At most 20 results per page; 60 requests per minute per IP. Only fields that are already public on the listing pages are returned — name, slug, category, city, phone, description, featured flag, the business's own public website link when supplied, and the public listing URL. Owner emails, owner IDs, and payment data are never exposed, and there is no bulk-export endpoint. Listing owners add or manage listings by signing in on the website itself (see https://www.localepak.com/auth.md). There are no write endpoints.
